# Safety Protocol
1. As a direct hire of NanoTrasen or the TSF, your safety is paramount. On [color=#ff0000]Code Red[/color] or above, all NT and TSF personnel should seek shelter, with the exception of the TSF Officer, who should continue their assigned protective duties.
2. In the event of [color=#ec9ba4]Code Gamma[/color], NT and TSF personnel are expected to work together, gather at the bridge or another secure command-designated location, and await ERT support.
3. During [color=#ec9ba4]Code Gamma[/color], the TSF Officer is responsible for protecting NT and TSF personnel, including the NanoTrasen Representative, Nanotrasen Career Trainer, Magistrate, and other protected personnel where applicable.
4. In the event of contract termination, NT and TSF personnel are expected to cooperate, remain together where possible, and await authorized extraction or escort. The TSF Officer is responsible for protecting NT and TSF personnel during this process.
